subject: Graph camera continuity and Riemann interaction profiling
scope: Frontend-only changes; verification kernels, prepared-input validation and inference grants are unchanged.

camera_regression.fix: Delete the resize-triggered fit controller; initial fit and explicit fit remain. Passive review labels pass pointer/wheel events through to the graph.

methodology: Actual installed Chrome, Riemann workspace, 175187 indexed files and a real 15-declaration compiled DictGen graph. No CPU/network throttling. All runs used reduced motion.
24 wheel events per zoom phase, 24 tab clicks, 40 hover pointer moves and 30 drag moves. Node selection includes eight node clicks plus one explicit Fit View click.
CDP EventDispatch spans measure renderer event processing. CPU profiles use approximately 1ms sampling and local source maps; these are sampled attribution, not exact function timings.
Input-to-two-animation-frames is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or field INP. Nested browser trace spans overlap.

Baseline frame intervals include profiler start/stop boundaries; those boundaries were excluded in later runs. Do not compare frame maxima across these captures. The report compares dispatch and input observations instead.
Wheel-end/debounce work can finish outside the action window; the trace is retained for inspection. A run with no recorded long task does not establish universal absence of stalls.
These are controlled local samples, not repeated field percentiles or hardware-independent latency guarantees. Setup cache validation is recorded separately.

The final timing capture preceded the passive-legend pointer-events change. That routing fix was validated in the final public browser regression, without forced clicks; it was not separately retimed.

runs.stage: Pruned visibility and suspended hidden map
Retained source page for selections within it

decoded_screens_reviewed: Lake inventory-change refusal and historical result

targeted_gui_final.note: The final legend-routing/camera/source-page recheck passed both selected cases. The earlier five distinct relevant journeys passed across focused runs; no single full GUI-suite pass is claimed.

checks.prior_gui_checks: Camera/hover, 10001-file map and retained tabs passed after branch pruning; source edit/mobile accessibility passed after page reuse. The new later-node selection exposed a real legend hit-test obstruction; fixed with pointer-events:none, without forced clicks or off-screen project repair.

adapters: The profiler is an opt-in development tool. It records locally, opens a prepared file through the public explorer and may validate its compile cache before recording. It makes no model requests and is not application telemetry.
